component.name: Lumen
component.summary: View, edit and annotate pictures and PDFs

description.p: Lumen is a fast viewer for pictures and PDF documents with the light editing and markup you reach for every day, in one native GNOME-style app.

ul.li: Open huge pictures and long PDFs without waiting: pages and pictures load in the background.
Open pictures one by one or a whole folder, drop in more from anywhere, see thumbnails, zoom and pan smoothly.
Rotate, flip, crop, resize and adjust colour, with undo. Rotating a JPEG does not recompress it.
Mark up pictures and PDFs with shapes, arrows, text, pen strokes and highlights. PDF annotations stay editable in other readers.
Fill in PDF forms and sign documents with a signature you draw once.
Open HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL and animated pictures, decoded in a sandbox so files from anywhere are safe to open.
Search PDF text, select and copy it, follow links and open the table of contents.
Rearrange PDFs: rotate, delete, reorder and insert pages, merge files, export pages.
Print through the native print dialog, run a slideshow, work in fullscreen.

screenshot.caption: Mark up a picture with shapes, arrows and text
Fill in and sign a PDF form
Annotate a PDF, with page thumbnails alongside
Crop with draggable handles and aspect ratios

description.p: Browse the folder of a single picture, go back after following a PDF link, move files to the trash, a night mode for PDFs and a command palette. Saving keeps permissions, symlinks and colour profiles, editing decodes in the sandbox, and thumbnails use the desktop cache.
SVG drawings stay sharp when you zoom in, and pictures take the orientation stored in their file again.
Scripting, and a fix for saving PDFs.

ul.li: Saving a PDF no longer asks afterwards whether to save the changes it just saved.
A D-Bus interface lets scripts open, fill in, annotate, edit, rearrange and save documents.
Pictures are decoded in a sandbox with glycin, which also adds HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL and more, and plays animated GIF, APNG and WebP.
Fill in PDF forms: text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and lists.
Draw your signature once and stamp it onto PDFs and pictures, or into a form's signature field.
Enter finishes a text note or field; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
